waivers.verdict: Hold — no claim tonight. Free agency reopens after Wednesday's run; on Friday, after the injury news, add Nick Folk for $0 (Santos or Bass if he's gone) and drop Jakobi Meyers.

lineup.verdict: Swap in Lamar Jackson, Tetairoa McMillan, Stefon Diggs and Tucker Kraft — three of your starters are on bye and scoring nothing, and Kraft has the better matchup. The kicker spot stays empty until Friday's waiver pickup.

trades.verdict: Hold — a full league-wide check found no offer certain to leave you better off. Your only real need, kicker and defense, is cheaper to fix on waivers than in a trade.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable yet — no games are underway or about to start. This week's games begin Thursday night, and none of your starters play in it; the real check comes Sunday morning.
